name: BIRD_ST_APPEAR_WAIT
meaning: teleported to the appear-box centre, visible; waits for 2 not-drawn updates, then circles

name: BIRD_ST_CIRCLE
meaning: quarter-turn orbits (radius 400 at first, anim 0); then re-circle or take off

name: BIRD_ST_TAKEOFF
meaning: 1 s straight flight at 500 u/s on the facing-quadrant axis, climbing 100 u/s (anim 2)

name: BIRD_ST_DESCEND
meaning: 1.5 s at 400 u/s, descending 66 u/s (anim 3); then re-centre the orbit and circle

name: BIRD_ST_LEAVE
meaning: anim 1 once; then waits until Ralph is inside an APPEARBOX. Entered when the bird is outside its box at a state change
